evidence: The column scan at x=16 reads a light top band (rows 5-8), then an abrupt step of about 56 L to the red apron at row 9 (L 97). Row 10 is darker (L 76) and acts as the eave shadow. Row 11 is a brown underside, and rows 12-15 are legs set back under the top. The front is a plain apron with no inset panels, so recessed_front is false, but the top band and apron are both clearly drawn.
